description: Expo (React Native) app for the TCG card portfolio, scanning, social feed, and trading platform — iOS, Android, and web from one codebase.

features.notes: DONE 2026-08-04 (human-directed close) -- 31/31 in-scope tasks [X], 181 tests passing, ./init.sh RESULT: SUCCESS (10/10 stages incl. the new iOS/Android bundle exports), tsc clean. Ships: personal + Tienda registration, phone verification with SMS autofill variants, the profile step (typed CURP/RFC fields per the re-scope), the KYC status gate, and the first-run tutorial. FOUR remaining tasks were MOVED OUT to 003-registration-kyc-completion rather than dropped: T021 (manual smoke -- web blocked on backend 006-web-cors, iOS partially verified), T022/T023 (US3 session persistence, deferred to backend 004-session-authentication), T035 (real tutorial endpoints, now that backend 002-onboarding-tutorial-state shipped them). CAVEATS THE HUMAN SHOULD KNOW BEFORE MERGING: (a) code-reviewer's second review returned CHANGES_REQUESTED on a blocking finding (setCurrentUserId never called -> every /identity/me/* and /phone/* call would 401); that was fixed as T033, but T033 and T034 landed AFTER that review and have NOT been re-reviewed by code-reviewer. (b) The end-to-end flow has never been run green against a live backend: web is blocked by the backend's missing CORS (registered there as 006-web-cors), and the happy path additionally needs real EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY plus the backend pointed at the same Supabase project (it currently runs AUTH_PROVIDER_MODE=mock, which creates a fake authProviderId the client cannot sign in against). Registration itself IS confirmed working against the real backend (HTTP 201 via curl and from the iOS simulator). (c) Four 'green tests, broken app' bugs were found by manual/real-backend testing that the test suite did not catch (T031 no session ever established, T033 X-User-Id never set, T034 unhandled sign-in rejection, plus an ExpoLinking native-module mismatch) -- treat 181 passing tests as necessary, not sufficient. PRIOR HISTORY -- RE-SCOPED 2026-08-04 (T001-T003 already [X], implementation resumed at new T004). task-implementer's mandatory backend cross-check during T001-T003 found the approved spec/plan/tasks targeted a backend scope that no longer exists: (1) backend descoped ALL KYC document handling out of its 001 into 002-kyc-document-verification (pending, unspec'd) on 2026-08-03 -- no presign endpoint, no object storage, no KYC provider; (2) backend has no path off kycStatus: pending at all (FR-006: KYC gates money paths only, not implemented here); (3) real backend flow is 3 calls -- POST /identity/register(/business) (email/password/phone/username only) -> POST /identity/phone/verify -> POST /identity/me/profile (nombre/apellidoPaterno/apellidoMaterno?/birthDate/nationality/curp/rfc as typed fields + ToS/privacy), not the assumed 2-step doc-upload flow; (4) business fields (commercialName/rfc/fiscalAddress) belong at the profile step, not registration. Orchestrator independently re-verified all findings against the backend's specs/001-user-registration-kyc/spec.md, prisma/schema.prisma, and feature_list.json (backend 001 is done, 117 tests). Human re-scope decisions encoded 2026-08-04: (A) document upload moved out to new frontend feature 002-kyc-document-verification (registered below, pending, blocked on backend 002 being spec'd); (B) kycStatus: pending now passes through to the main app (resolveKycRoute/KycStatusScreen stay, but only route to kyc-status on rejected or a fetch-failure -- rejected is unreachable against the current backend, built-and-tested via mocked fixtures, not dead code); (C) added a profile-step screen gated behind phone verification. spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md all amended accordingly; FR-004 rewritten (typed profile fields, was documents), FR-009 rewritten (routing gate matrix, decision B), original document-related FR-004/FR-008/SC-004/AS/platform-notes/edge-cases preserved verbatim under each file's 'Deferred to feature 002' section. tasks.md: T001-T003 stay [X] with unchanged numbering; new T004/T005 are follow-ups to already-completed T002 (remove IdentityDocument -- moved to 002, not kept as forward declaration; add backend-mirroring User fields) and T003 (widen resolveKycRoute's route union/branches per decision B) respectively; former T005/T006/T014/T015/T016/T017 (presign/upload/confirm, camera-upload adapter, permission screen, doc-upload screens) relocated verbatim to a 'Deferred to feature 002' section at the bottom of tasks.md. Also notes an unresolved constraint (not solved by this feature): backend /identity/me/* and /identity/phone/* authenticate via a dev-only X-User-Id header until backend 003-session-authentication (pending) ships -- recorded in spec.md Assumptions, affects US3 and every authenticated call. See progress/current.md for the full session log.

Registered 2026-08-04 as part of re-scoping 001-registration-kyc: KYC document upload (official ID + proof of life capture, presign->PUT->confirm upload flow, the pre-permission explanation screen, camera-permission/offline-retry edge cases) was moved out of 001 into this feature, mirroring the same split already made on the backend (backend's KYC-document feature, RENUMBERED to 003-kyc-document-verification as of 2026-08-04 -- the backend inserted 002-onboarding-tutorial-state ahead of it, so every 'backend 002' reference written earlier in this repo means backend 003; still pending/unspec'd). No spec.md written yet -- deliberately not spec'd until the backend's own 003 is spec'd first, since this feature's contract (endpoints, field names, kycStatus transition mechanics) has no backend counterpart to mirror yet. All the original 001 requirements/acceptance-scenarios/platform-notes/edge-cases/tasks this feature should start from are preserved verbatim in specs/001-registration-kyc/spec.md's and tasks.md's 'Deferred to feature 002' sections -- read those first. Also owns: kycStatus transitions away from pending (verified/rejected), enforcement of the money-path KYC gate (sale/withdrawal only, not card-for-card trades, per backend FR-006), and whatever CTA destination 001's KycStatusScreen's 'Resubmit documents' placeholder route should eventually point to.

Created 2026-08-04 to hold the four tasks that were still open when 001-registration-kyc was closed at the human's direction. These are NOT abandoned work -- each is carried over verbatim, with its full context, in specs/001-registration-kyc/tasks.md's 'Moved to feature 003' section; read that first, it is the source of truth for scope. Contents: (1) T035 -- switch tutorial completion from local-only expo-secure-store to the real GET /identity/me/tutorials + POST /identity/me/tutorials/complete, which the backend's 002-onboarding-tutorial-state shipped on 2026-08-04. This is a genuine FR-007 correctness fix, not cleanup: local-only completion is lost on reinstall and does not follow a user across devices, so the tutorial replays for a user who has already seen it, meeting 'once per install' but not FR-007's 'once per user'. THE ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR NOT BLOCKED ON ANYTHING EXTERNAL -- start here. (2) T022/T023 -- US3 session persistence, deferred by human decision on 2026-08-04 because it cannot work until the backend's 004-session-authentication ships: the backend has no full-profile GET (only GET /me/kyc-status, returning { kycStatus } alone), and X-User-Id is in-memory only, so every cold boot fails the status fetch and lands on FR-010's retry screen. BLOCKED on backend 004. (3) T021 -- the manual smoke check 001 never completed. Web is BLOCKED on the backend's missing CORS (tracked there as 006-web-cors); iOS is partially verified (register screen confirmed against the live backend, HTTP 201) but the happy path additionally needs real EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY and the backend moved off AUTH_PROVIDER_MODE=mock onto the same Supabase project. Android was never exercised -- no Android SDK on the dev machine as of 2026-08-04. Also worth folding in here: a code-reviewer pass over 001's T033/T034, which landed after the last review and were never re-reviewed. No spec.md written yet.
